floors_confirmed_by.note: computed on a code path independent of suite_composition; both agree

known_limits: 21 verified MULLIGAN keys are EXCLUDED, and the mechanical reason (no numbered menu for shuffle_suite to permute) is not the real one. Mulligan is a BINARY decision, so its floor is 0.50 at the theoretical best -- above the 'prefer floors near zero' rule this whole suite is built on. Measured today it is far worse: the 21 keys split 17 KEEP / 4 MULLIGAN, so 'always KEEP' scores 0.81. Worse still, the mined prompt itself tells the model 'Keeping a workable hand almost always beats shrinking it', i.e. it leans toward the majority class. Before this axis can be quoted it needs class balance, many more MULLIGAN-answer keys, and a prompt that does not hand over the prior. Reported separately from PUZ if ever -- never folded into it.
Every key carries unprobed_replay_address (minted with --driver none), so the replay address was never engine-probed.
n_clusters 23 < n 25: two pairs of positions come from the same game, so CIs are cluster-bootstrapped, not binomial.
No live model has ever been scored against this suite. Only offline policies (which are the floor generators) have run.

SNAPSHOT DEFECT (found 2026-08-02, fixed for future corpora): the 'mana available' line double-counted basic lands (subtype + intrinsic mana ability), e.g. 2 untapped Mountains rendered {R:4}. Rows frozen in this suite embed the wrong tally (50/65 affected in puz-v2.1 by the strict test). Scores on this suite reflect models coping with self-contradictory mana state; cross-suite comparisons to post-fix suites are not mana-line-equivalent.
